description: Independent acceptance review. Use only through skill://reviewer/SKILL.md when review is requested or required. Checks only the agreed work, including omissions and unauthorized additions. Receives only the supplied packet and installed review rules: no memory, parent history or tools. A finding does not authorize extra work.
level: blind uses Terra high; high uses Terra xhigh. No fallback model.
packet: Complete packet from the reviewer skill: verbatim user messages, source-linked requirements, stage, complete review object, applicable project rules and source evidence. Include source contents, not unread paths or your assurances. Never include memory or earlier reviewer verdicts.

errors.model: Review model unavailable. No fallback review was run.
errors.auth: Review credentials unavailable. Review did not pass.
errors.incomplete: Incomplete review response. Do not treat it as acceptance.
